summary: The change modifies the `release` function's idempotency guard from an unconditional return-on-duplicate to a time-bounded (1-day) return. After the window elapses, a replayed instruction will fall through and send a second disbursement to core banking, directly violating PAY-2 ('Releasing the same payment instruction again never sends a second disbursement'). The prior acceptance-ledger evidence for PAY-2 (ACR-0403) is lapsed by this behavioural change under LAP-1, and no replacement evidence is supplied. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1) are satisfied, but the critical product-obligation violation mandates rejection.
